title: Typed retry contract for first-call index_unavailable and cluster_cold_load (MCP and CLI): retryRecommended/retryHint plus server_capabilities progress
outcome: Owner ruling 2026-09-03 (Greg): the cold-start first-call refusal is expected behavior and works as designed; this item only makes the retry contract explicit and typed for agents on both the MCP and CLI surfaces. Filed from Phoenix::Fable finding #55 in the CLI review cycle.
acceptance: First-call index_unavailable and cluster_cold_load payloads carry retryRecommended:true, a retryHint naming server_capabilities.index.progress, and the same guidance in docs/agent-instructions.md; a product-boundary test proves the fields on a cold start; no new limits, no auto-retry

completion.summary: Shipped typed retryRecommended/retryHint contracts for index and semantic cold-start failures across MCP/CLI surfaces, honest follower-aware availability classification, bounded context_pack fallback, synchronized guidance, feature manifest entry, version bump, and decisive regressions.
